waitlist.shareText: I'm on the waitlist for Multiverse Echoes — an AI life simulation. Join using my referral link!
waitlist.step1Desc: Tell us who you'd be. Your age, your personality, the choices that define you. Quick mode or detailed — your call.
waitlist.step2Desc: Your Echo lives autonomously in themed Shards — cyberpunk cities, Renaissance Florence, the Australian outback. You observe, nudge, never control.
waitlist.step3Desc: Export your Echo's diary as video, PDF, or text. Share the moments that surprise you. Every story is unique.
waitlist.socialProofDesc: Multiverse Echoes is built by one person on a single machine. No VC funding, no corporate roadmap. Just a vision of what AI simulation can become.
waitlist.socialProofQuote: "The most interesting stories are the ones you didn't write."
